description: The brain's regression test. Answers are checked against the rendered brain.md by substring, never by a model: a model asked whether its own document is right will say yes. The questions that must NOT be answerable are the useful half. They catch a brain that invents, and a brain that keeps a fact after its source dropped it. Expectations are keyed by document version, because a deleted source is only believed after the grace period: facts from docs/security.md and brand.md's colour line are still present in v2 and gone in v3.

questions.question: What is the company's name?
What is the tagline?
How much is the Starter plan per month?
questions.note: The email announced $59 before the repo said so. In v1 this is the precedence rule working; in v2 both sources agree.

questions.question: How much is the Growth plan per month?
Which licence does the product ship under?
Which version of the Waypoint SDK does the ranking service pin?
Who is the Chief Executive Officer?
Who is the Head of Customer Success?
questions.note: Removed from docs/team.md in v2 and confirmed by email. The brain must stop asserting it.

questions.question: Which third-party TMS does the product integrate with?
questions.note: Kestrel drops out of docs/integrations.md in v2. The file still exists, so the fact is removed in the same run: a source that still speaks and stops saying something has decided, and there is no ambiguity to wait out.

questions.question: How often is carrier capacity refreshed?
questions.note: One section of a six-section FAQ changes. Only that section is re-extracted; the other five cost nothing.

questions.question: How many days is customer shipment data retained?
questions.note: docs/security.md is deleted in v2, so every fact sourced only from it is tombstoned.

questions.question: Which compliance certification does the company hold?
questions.note: Its source file is gone, so it survives one more sync before removal: an outage and a deletion look identical for one run.

questions.question: What is the brand colour?
questions.note: The line is deleted from brand.md in v2. Its source file is gone, so it survives one more sync before removal: an outage and a deletion look identical for one run.

questions.question: Where is the European office?
questions.note: Announced by email between the two runs.

questions.question: Who is the site reliability engineer?
What is Sofia Marchetti's mobile number?
questions.note: Scrubbed before the text ever reached a model. If this question can be answered, the scrubber failed.

questions.question: Is the Starter plan free?
questions.note: Asserted only by a prompt-injection email from a sender who is not on the allowlist.

questions.question: Is Bob Vance the Chief Executive Officer?
questions.note: The same injection attempt. The allowlist is checked in code, before any model call.

questions.question: What is the stated p95 planning latency?
What is on the roadmap for intermodal shipments?
questions.note: roadmap.md is renamed in v2 with identical bytes. A rename must not read as a deletion.

questions.question: How is data at rest encrypted?
questions.note: Its source file is gone, so it survives one more sync before removal: an outage and a deletion look identical for one run.
